; secondary-pen-toolbar: show the built-in "Secondary pen" in the toolbar,
; right after the primary pen.
;
; xochitl already has a second pen (own tool, colour and size, remembered per
; document), but it only shows when the toolbar's slot logic puts it in the main
; row. On small screens (Paper Pro Move) it always loses its slot and hides itself.
;
; The main editing tools come from a Repeater over xochitl's tool model, so nothing
; can be inserted between them directly. This wraps the Repeater's delegate: every
; tool is drawn exactly as before, and the delegate of the primary pen additionally
; loads one instance of xochitl's own SecondaryPenMenu right next to it.
;
; The toolbar decides how many tools fit (showableToolsCount) without counting the
; pinned pen, so the row would be one button too long and the last button (three
; dots) would slide under the close button. Instead of dropping a tool, the tool
; buttons share the space: each gets slightly narrower when needed.

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/Toolbar.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope
        LOCATE AFTER showableToolsCount
        INSERT {
            readonly property bool pinnedPenHorizontal: toolLayout.flow === GridLayout.LeftToRight
            // Room for the tools after the hide/show button: at most showableToolsCount
            // stock tools + the pinned pen. Full size if they fit, else shared equally.
            readonly property real pinnedPenToolExtent: {
                const size = ArkTokens.Style.variable.controlsHeight.large;
                const length = (pinnedPenHorizontal ? toolLayout.width : toolLayout.height) - size;
                const count = Math.max(1, showableToolsCount + 1);
                return Math.max(1, Math.min(size, Math.floor(length / count)));
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
    TRAVERSE FocusScope > Item#toolbar > GridLayout#toolLayout > Repeater#editingTools
        REPLACE delegate WITH {
            delegate: GridLayout {
                id: editingToolSlot
                required property var model
                required property int index
                flow: toolLayout.flow
                rowSpacing: 0
                columnSpacing: 0
                // The stock secondary pen (if the toolbar ever gives it a slot) is replaced by the pinned one.
                readonly property bool stockShown: editingToolLoader.shown && editingToolSlot.model.tool !== ToolbarModel.SecondaryPen
                // Not based on the children's `visible`: a child of an invisible item reads
                // as invisible, so the slot could never become visible again.
                visible: root.expanded && (stockShown || pinnedSecondaryPenLoader.active)
                z: editingToolLoader.z

                ToolLoader {
                    id: editingToolLoader
                    model: editingToolSlot.model
                    objectName: "editingToolLoader_" + item?.objectName
                    buttonType: ToolbarTool.Type.ToolbarButton
                    toolbar: root
                    antialiasing: root.antialiasing
                    asynchronous: !root.visible
                    visible: editingToolSlot.stockShown && root.expanded
                    z: item?.totalHeight > root.height ? 1 : 0
                    onSelect: (tool) => root._select(tool)
                    Layout.preferredWidth: root.pinnedPenHorizontal ? root.pinnedPenToolExtent : -1
                    Layout.preferredHeight: root.pinnedPenHorizontal ? -1 : root.pinnedPenToolExtent
                }

                Loader {
                    id: pinnedSecondaryPenLoader
                    active: editingToolSlot.model.tool === ToolbarModel.PrimaryPen
                    visible: active && root.expanded
                    Layout.preferredWidth: root.pinnedPenHorizontal ? root.pinnedPenToolExtent : -1
                    Layout.preferredHeight: root.pinnedPenHorizontal ? -1 : root.pinnedPenToolExtent
                    sourceComponent: SecondaryPenMenu {
                        objectName: "pinnedSecondaryPenMenu"
                        toolbar: root
                        type: ToolbarTool.Type.ToolbarButton
                        group: ToolbarModel.Editing
                        antialiasing: root.antialiasing
                        onSelect: (tool) => root._select(tool)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
    TRAVERSE FocusScope > Item#toolbar > GridLayout#toolLayout > Repeater#secondaryTools
        REPLACE delegate WITH {
            delegate: ToolLoader {
                objectName: "secondaryToolLoader_" + item?.objectName
                buttonType: ToolbarTool.Type.ToolbarButton
                toolbar: root
                antialiasing: root.antialiasing
                asynchronous: !root.visible
                visible: shown && root.expanded
                z: item?.totalHeight > root.height ? 1 : 0
                onSelect: (tool) => root._select(tool)
                Layout.preferredWidth: root.pinnedPenHorizontal ? root.pinnedPenToolExtent : -1
                Layout.preferredHeight: root.pinnedPenHorizontal ? -1 : root.pinnedPenToolExtent
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
